adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#removeMember`, after the DELETE it simply calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. In `findMembers()`, the request offset is clamped using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (`var offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`), but `user_count` is stale immediately after a removal (it’s only updated from `result.meta.total` after the AJAX call returns). On the server side (`GroupsController#members`), `offset` is taken directly from params and not clamped against `total`, so if you were on the last page and removed the last member, the subsequent reload can request an offset beyond the new total and return an empty `members` array while leaving `meta.offset` unchanged. This matches the reported behavior: empty page / currentPage beyond the real last page instead of stepping back.
